title: Astor Johnson Repertory Dance Theatre: Branches
summary: A two-hour Friday school-show performance of the 2026 Branches dance season at Queen's Hall for TT$50.
description: Astor Johnson Repertory Dance Theatre presents Branches at Queen's Hall. The Friday 2 October school show runs 10:00 am–12:00 noon and is listed at TT$50, with a TT$100 senior-citizen price for that Friday performance. The previously advertised TT$200 early-bird offer ended 18 September and is not treated as current.

places.name: Queen's Hall

price.label: TT$50 Friday school show
price.terms: Senior citizens TT$100 for the Friday school show.
